svg.title: SignDuplex translation quality on continuous multi-sentence input
svg.desc: Final paper Table 4, continuous multi-sentence input. All strategies use the same Uni-Sign translation model. BLEU-4 values: Offline 8.20, SL segmentation 11.85, Online CSLR/SLT 10.90, SignDuplex 13.72, ideal boundary reference 14.38. Higher is better. SignDuplex improves BLEU-4 by 67.3 percent relative to Offline. The reference uses ground-truth sentence boundaries. Bar axes start at zero.
